description: The 'dss_webapps_live' dataset provides comprehensive information about live web applications, primarily used for tracking and managing these applications within a project environment. Each entry in the dataset represents a unique web application, identified by a 'webapp_id'. The dataset includes descriptive details such as the 'webapp_name' and 'webapp_type', which help in categorizing and understanding the purpose of each application. It also tracks the 'projectKey', linking each web application to its respective project. The dataset is useful for administrators and developers to monitor the operational status of web applications, indicated by the 'backend_running' column, and to manage user access and modifications through 'created_by_user' and 'last_modified_user'. Additionally, timestamps for creation and last modification provide insights into the application's lifecycle. The 'tags' column allows for categorization and filtering, while 'is_code_webapp' distinguishes between code-based and non-code-based applications. The 'url' column provides direct access to the web application, facilitating easy navigation and management. This dataset is essential for maintaining an organized and efficient web application environment, ensuring that all applications are up-to-date and properly managed.
shortDesc: Dataset of live web applications with details on type, creator, and status.

columns.name: webapp_id
columns.comment: Unique identifier for each web application. Key for tracking.

columns.name: webapp_name
columns.comment: Descriptive name of the web application. Identifies purpose.

columns.name: projectKey
columns.comment: Identifier for the associated project. Links app to project.

columns.name: webapp_type
columns.comment: Type or category of the web application. Defines function.

columns.name: backend_running
columns.comment: Indicates if the backend is currently running. Status check.

columns.name: created_by_user
columns.comment: Email of the user who created the app. Creator identity.

columns.name: last_modified_user
columns.comment: Email of the user who last modified the app. Modifier identity.

columns.name: created_timestamp
columns.comment: Timestamp when the app was created. Tracks creation date.

columns.name: last_modified_timestamp
columns.comment: Timestamp of the last modification. Tracks update date.

columns.name: tags
columns.comment: JSON array of tags for categorization. Organizes apps.

columns.name: is_code_webapp
columns.comment: Indicates if the app is code-based. Differentiates app type.

columns.name: url
columns.comment: URL for accessing the web application. Direct access link.
